article.headline: Hammond scores 34, Northern Colorado beats Detroit Mercy 93-83
article.description: — Jeremiah Hammond’s 34 points led Northern Colorado over Detroit Mercy 93-83 in a consolation game at the Cancun Challenge on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Hammond scores 34, Northern Colorado beats Detroit Mercy 93-83

categories.description: Northern Colorado Bears @ Detroit Mercy Titans

event.description: Northern Colorado Bears @ Detroit Mercy Titans

keywords: Northern Colorado Bears @ Detroit Mercy Titans
article.story: CANCUN, Mexico -- — Jeremiah Hammond’s 34 points led Northern Colorado over Detroit Mercy 93-83 in a consolation game at the Cancun Challenge on Wednesday. Hammond shot 10 of 17 from the field, including 8 for 13 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line for the Bears (4-4). Andrew Crawford scored 13 points and added six rebounds. Hunter Caldwell finished with 11 points. Ayden Carter led the Titans (0-7) in scoring, finishing with 26 points and six rebounds. Tyler Spratt added 14 points and 11 rebounds for Detroit Mercy. London Maiden finished with 14 points and three blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
